data.title: Speed challenge: count the capitals
story: Write a function count_capitals(text) that counts how many capital letters are in the text.
A for loop can read text letter by letter, and c.isupper() is True when c is a capital letter.

explanation: for c in text takes one letter per round, and c.isupper() checks whether that letter is a capital. Numbers and spaces are not capital letters, so they are not counted.
hints: Start with count = 0, then for c in text:
Inside the loop: if c.isupper(): add 1 to count.
Do not forget return count outside the loop.
